summary: Silicom Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on July 29, 2026, to report its second quarter 2026 financial results via a press release. The filing discloses a 59% year-over-year revenue increase to $23.8 million, a GAAP net loss of $2.1 million ($0.37 per share) and a non-GAAP net loss of $0.9 million ($0.16 per share). Management raised full-year revenue guidance to $93-$95 million, citing strong core business momentum and AI-Inference orders. The CEO expressed optimism for a return to quarterly non-GAAP profitability by year-end. No transaction, merger, tender offer, or other special-situation corporate event is announced. This is a routine earnings release; thus, no special-situations category applies.
